purpose: B-834: serve brinedew.bio and geneguessr.brinedew.bio documents and assets straight from Cloudflare Pages (free, unlimited static requests). Only API and admin paths run a Worker. Reconciled by scripts/reconcile-brinedew-static-edge-policy.mjs.

otherPagesProjects.purpose: Curvarium, the library of lifespan curves. Its own repository deploys its own Pages project, so its releases never wait on this site's pipeline. Pure static files: no Worker, no D1.

imageHostPurpose: B-1087: readers fetch portraits, blots and the stable card objects through img.brinedew.bio, a proxied name for the Bunny pull zone. Cloudflare's free cache serves the repeats, so Bunny bills only cache misses and its prepaid balance can't run out on a viral day. The pull zone knows the name from bunny/the-only-iconoplasm-pull-zone-policy.json. The origin keeps sending its own Cache-Control (immutable files 30 days, mutable card objects 60 s).

redirectRules.description: Apex GeneGuessr privacy document -> its own host

rewriteRules.description: geneguessr.brinedew.bio/ serves the GeneGuessr Pages document
geneguessr.brinedew.bio/privacy serves the GeneGuessr privacy Pages document

configRules.description: B-858: Cloudflare must not inject its Web Analytics beacon; pages load the consent-gated one themselves
B-1087: img.brinedew.bio's origin is the Bunny pull zone, which presents its own *.b-cdn.net certificate; Full encrypts the hop without matching the name

cacheRules.description: B-1087: cache every img.brinedew.bio response (JSON is not in Cloudflare's default extension list) for as long as the origin's Cache-Control allows
cacheRules.browserTtlWhy: The zone's Browser Cache TTL (4 hours) raises any shorter origin max-age. Card objects are max-age=60 because a vote can change their winner, so browsers must keep the origin's lifetime.
